bullets.text: Q2 CR 90.4; YTD CR 89.6; Property ran less profitably than target at 109.0 CR (103.6 YTD) after $42.0M Q2 aggregate stop-loss recoverable, predominantly due to elevated weather.
Total NPW grew 13% in Q2 and 14% YTD; results aligned with expectations across all areas except Property profitability, thrilling leadership especially given the competitive environment.
Property catastrophe losses +31% YOY to $193.0M YTD; Q2 events added $131.4M, driven by Texas wind, hail, thunderstorms, and widespread tornadoes; YTD stop-loss recoverable reached $81.5M.
Auto frequency fell 4% in Q2, marking the 10th consecutive quarterly decline, while severity rose 8%; YTD frequency decreased 3% against an 8% increase in severity.
Diligent rate revisions maintained because customers prefer stable rates; loss frequency and severity trends are watched closely at the state, consumer segment, and individual product levels.

Investment portfolio returned 2.2% in Q2 (fixed income 2.1%, common stocks 4.0%) and 5.5% YTD; equities, credit spreads, and treasuries rallied on expected Fed rate cuts and reduced trade war rhetoric.
Commercial Lines launched a Business Owners Policy for small businesses via select Ohio agents; Property 4.0 design rolled out in Michigan with plans for five additional states.
HQX Buy, enabling direct online quoting and buying for Progressive Home, is planned for 10 states this year, bringing the projected year-end total to 14 states.

Vision statement was revised to include consumers and agents across auto, home, and other insurance, believed to signal agent importance as Progressive continues its endeavor into the Destination era.

Progressive ranked in the 96th percentile on Gallup's engagement index; nearly all 40,000 employees participate in Gainsharing; nine ERGs support inclusion, and 'Own It' aids internal career development.
